This directory contains the official, unmodified Windows x64 potrace.exe.
The complete corresponding upstream Potrace source archive is included at
source/potrace-1.16.tar.gz. Copying conditions are in COPYING; original author
credits, usage documentation and build documentation are retained alongside it.

Upstream project: https://potrace.sourceforge.net/
Official Windows archive:
https://potrace.sourceforge.net/download/1.16/potrace-1.16.win64.zip
Official source archive:
https://potrace.sourceforge.net/download/1.16/potrace-1.16.tar.gz
Hashes and provenance are recorded in upstream.json.

Vector Migic invokes the separate command-line program on its own temporary
binary bitmap masks and reads the generated SVG paths. No system installation,
PATH modification, network service, or Vector Magic application code is used.

Potrace is a trademark of Peter Selinger. Vector Migic is an independent MITOM
application; it is not a modified or renamed Potrace binary.

Rebuilding or replacing the CLI:
1. Extract the supplied source archive.
2. Follow the archive's INSTALL and README instructions using an appropriate
   Windows x64 C build toolchain (for example, a MinGW-w64 configure/make setup).
   The --disable-zlib option is available when compression support is not needed.
3. Replace vendor/potrace/potrace.exe with your built executable and update
   upstream.json to describe the replacement and its exact SHA256. Also update
   the reviewed binary hash in engine.py and packaging/prepare_assets.py; when
   replacing its source archive, update that archive's hash in prepare_assets.py.
   These checks are included as source so a replacement can be rebuilt without
   disabling the application's file-integrity verification.
4. Keep the matching source, license and copyright notices with redistribution.
5. Rebuild Vector Migic using the complete source and SOURCE-REBUILD.txt included
   in the application's notices directory.
